_comment: Recording cue list of week 01, derived from the deck's own cue declarations by scripts/build_cues.py (plan/22_recording_track.txt). One segment per pointer action in lecture order; kind action | process | static; seconds are planning estimates; no spoken text. Extra fields: scene, cue_target (data-cue-target in the deck), deck_action, expect_state (data-state after the action in record=1 mode).
route_note: The recall-and-outcomes page is skipped in the recorded route; the opening situation is operated inside the opening window.
